entries.SILENT.cardsModifierDescription: Silent cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
entries.SILENT.description:
A huntress from outside the Spire.
Ready to stab and poison anything in her way.
entries.SILENT.eventDeathPrevention: Must live on to hunt another day...
entries.SILENT.goldMonologue: [sine]My sisters would be proud of these riches...[/sine]
entries.SILENT.title: The Silent
entries.SILENT.unlockText: Play a single run to unlock this character.

entries.SILENT1_EPOCH.description:
News of the [gold]Spire’s[/gold] reopening made its way to the [green]Silent[/green].
She ferries a boat to [blue]The Capital[/blue].
entries.SILENT1_EPOCH.title: Fog Rolls In
entries.SILENT1_EPOCH.unlock: The [green]Silent[/green] sneaks past the gatewards with ease and enters the [gold]Spire[/gold] once more...
entries.SILENT1_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Played|Play} a run with the [red]Ironclad[/red]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
entries.SILENT1_EPOCH.unlockText: Unlocked the [green]Silent[/green] as a playable character.
entries.SILENT2_EPOCH.description:
The other sisters judge the fourth one in silence...
 They have not seen her for over [blue]three centuries[/blue] and she returns with an [jitter][purple]ugly[/purple][/jitter] [sine][blue]pulsating[/blue][/sine] [red]scrap[/red].

[green]The Silent[/green] recollects the trials she endured for this trophy but does not speak; to speak is weak. One can only prove herself with more impressive trophies.

There is always bigger prey.
entries.SILENT2_EPOCH.title: Bigger Prey
entries.SILENT2_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Beat [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] with the [green]Silent[/green]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
entries.SILENT3_EPOCH.description:
A sickness carrying a [sine]familiar scent[/sine] courses through the [green]Silent’s[/green] veins, the [purple]Heart piece[/purple] is slowly killing her!
The [purple]grotesque trophy[/purple] is hurled into the ocean, but the blight has no cure.

She will die soon.
entries.SILENT3_EPOCH.title: Ill
entries.SILENT3_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Beat [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] with the [green]Silent[/green]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
entries.SILENT4_EPOCH.description: Fantastic trophies occupy this forsaken place. All were defeated, one by one. Those marked by the Silent always fall.
entries.SILENT4_EPOCH.title: Trophies
entries.SILENT4_EPOCH.unlock:
The [green]Silent[/green] hungers for a greater challenge...
[red]Ascensions[/red] are now available when starting a run.
entries.SILENT4_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Beat [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]3[/blue] with the [green]Silent[/green]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
entries.SILENT5_EPOCH.description:
Another hunt concludes.

Stilling the putrid Heart with a [sine]special-made poison[/sine], the [green]Silent[/green] rappels upwards and outwards and longs to bathe in the comforting moonlight. She leaves the [gold]Spire[/gold] with a prize in hand. A piece of the [purple]Heart[/purple].
entries.SILENT5_EPOCH.title: Poisoner
entries.SILENT5_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Killed|Kill} [blue]15[/blue] [purple]Elites[/purple] with the [green]Silent[/green]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
entries.SILENT6_EPOCH.description:
Ghastly nightmares of [sine][purple]tormented souls[/purple][/sine] stalk the [green]Foglands[/green].

She takes it upon herself to hunt the haunter. Once the hunt is complete, its skull is ceremoniously placed upon her by her [green]Sisters[/green]. The ritual has concluded.
entries.SILENT6_EPOCH.title: Nemesis
entries.SILENT6_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Killed|Kill} [blue]15[/blue] [red]Bosses[/red] with the [green]Silent[/green]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
entries.SILENT7_EPOCH.description:
[sine]“Hello, little one...!”[/sine] the massive [orange]Tezcatara[/orange] whispered to the [green]Silent[/green].

“Grow big and strong!” The Ancient speaks in a tender tone and scoots over a bowl of nutritious [sine]soup[/sine].
entries.SILENT7_EPOCH.title: Soup
entries.SILENT7_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Beat [red]Ascension[/red] [blue]1[/blue] with the [green]Silent[/green]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
